_notes: Isa 61:7 — Vulgate distributes this verse across two breviary lines with internal * in each; the 思高 text is continuous, so the split follows the Latin sense divisions. Isa 62:4 — 思高 renders 'inhabitáta/inhabitábitur' as 「已婚的」/将要婚嫁 (reflecting Hebrew בְּעוּלָה, 'married'), preserving the 思高 wordplay. Isa 63:1 — Vulgate divides the verse into three breviary sub-lines; 思高 has a two-part structure (question + answer); the third sub-line (Ego qui loquor…) is the divine answer rendered accordingly. Isa 66:10 — The breviary splits 66:10 across two lines at a point that bridges 思高 v.10 and the beginning of v.11; the second half-verse (sugátis et repleámini) corresponds to 思高 66:11 content but is labelled 66:10 in the Vulgate breviary — followed text based on 思高 66:11 wording for the second half.
